visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up of a clear food processor bowl where pieces of cooked sweet potato, blocks of butter, and granulated sugar are being mixed. A hand holding a black spatula is visible briefly. (2) The camera cuts to a medium shot of a woman with black hair tied back, wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt, working in a bright kitchen. She is seen portioning dough and weighing it on a small white digital scale on a marble countertop. (3) In a series of close-ups and medium shots, the woman fills rounds of dough with brown red bean paste and a translucent mochi filling using gloved hands. She then carefully pinches the dough to seal it. (4) The woman rolls out a large piece of dough with a marble rolling pin, spreads a yellow sweet potato mixture over it with a white spatula, and then braids two long strips of filled dough together on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. (5) Close-up shots show the woman brushing a vibrant yellow egg wash onto the braided loaves and the round buns, then sprinkling almond flakes and black sesame seeds on top. (6) The woman, smiling, holds up a tray of unbaked braided loaves. The scene then transitions to the loaves being placed into a modern white oven and later being removed, now golden brown and puffed. (7) Finally, the woman pulls apart one of the round buns with her hands, revealing the soft interior with red bean and mochi filling, while several finished loaves rest on cooling racks in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle cooking vlog where the creator shares a recipe for sweet potato and red bean mochi bread while reflecting on the emotional transition of her daughter starting university and moving out. It aims to connect with other parents through shared experiences of 'empty nest' feelings while providing culinary inspiration.
